description: The scapula is the triangular shoulder blade, floating over the rib cage and framing the arm's range of motion with sweeping planes and crisp ridges for artists to map.

landmarks.name: Superior angle
landmarks.desc: Rounded upper corner that meets the levator scapulae and softens the neck-shoulder junction.

landmarks.name: Inferior angle
landmarks.desc: Low tapered point that glides over the ribs and signals scapular rotation.

landmarks.name: Medial border
landmarks.desc: Long inner edge hugging the thorax, a key line for blocking in the back.

landmarks.name: Lateral border
landmarks.desc: Thicker outer edge leading into the axilla and framing the teres muscles.

landmarks.name: Acromion process
landmarks.desc: Broad shelf over the shoulder joint where deltoid and trapezius trade planes.

landmarks.name: Coracoid process
landmarks.desc: Hook-like projection felt below the clavicle, anchoring coracoid muscles.

landmarks.name: Spine of scapula
landmarks.desc: Prominent ridge separating the supra- and infraspinous fossae with a crisp shadow edge.

landmarks.name: Glenoid cavity
landmarks.desc: Shallow socket for the humeral head, bordered by tubercles for arm tendons.

landmarks.name: Supraspinous fossa
landmarks.desc: Smooth concavity above the spine cradling supraspinatus.

landmarks.name: Infraspinous fossa
landmarks.desc: Broad posterior basin giving mass to the upper back.

landmarks.name: Subscapular fossa
landmarks.desc: Shallow anterior surface pressed to the rib cage and filled by subscapularis.

landmarks.name: Supraglenoid tubercle
landmarks.desc: Small bump above the glenoid that launches the long head of biceps.

landmarks.name: Infraglenoid tubercle
landmarks.desc: Prominence below the glenoid giving purchase to the long head of triceps.
